interpretation.gzip: Per-file gzip estimate; actual HTTP encoding/cache is measured by browser resources.
interpretation.routes: Static JS dependency closure plus separately named route CSS. CSS inherited from other chunks and dynamic preload CSS are not assigned to routes here; browser resource timings measure actual CSS bytes.
interpretation.dynamicImports: Reachability edges only, not proof of initial download.
interpretation.pwa: Parsed emitted service worker precache URLs; browser baseline blocks service worker, so this is separate install cost.
interpretation.allAssets: Includes lazy code/media/public files; never an initial-load budget.
